scope: gfx1151 Poolside Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M BF16-KV eager c=1 selected Q4 down projection

change.description: Load adjacent Q4 T16 columns' packed nibble, aligned d/dmin FP16 pairs, and scale/min byte pairs once while preserving each column's original F32 FMA, four-wave reduction, BF16 route store, and slot-order weighted output.

leaf.protocol: 21 counterbalanced samples x 100 launches after 5 warmups

same_resident_gate.workload: p512/d128 eager c=1, matrix rows 2048, attention rows 128
same_resident_gate.protocol: seven counterbalanced pairs in one resident session; load excluded

trace.protocol: cache-only rocprofv3 kernel trace; no compiler under profiler

commands.leaf: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_selected_natural_decode_leaf.py --gate-candidate tile8-parallel-silu-interleaved --down-candidate paircoeff-weighted --warmups 5 --samples 21 --burst 100 --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-q4-down-paircoeff-weighted-leaf.json
commands.model_gate: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 HIPENGINE_LAGUNA_F16_DECODE=fixedk PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-selected-down-q4-paircoeff-weighted-decode --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-p512-d128-q4-down-paircoeff-sevenpair.json

decision: Retain as the gfx1151 default. Exact leaf output, lower kernel median, VGPR contraction, positive median wall, and five of seven paired wins agree. Publish a tracked-clean selector-unset production run before updating the canonical topline.
